title: Boost Morning Energy with Simple Hacks

scenes.text: Three quick tricks to energize your morning at home

scenes.label: DRINK COLD WATER
scenes.text: Drink a glass of cold water right after waking

scenes.label: SUNLIGHT EXPOSURE
scenes.text: Get five to ten minutes of natural sunlight within the first hour

scenes.label: LIGHT MOVEMENT
scenes.text: Do five minutes of gentle stretching or walking
Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: Start your day with three easy, science‑backed habits that boost alertness and mood. Try them tomorrow and feel the difference. Follow for more practical health tips.
